name: Veles.JB.mem_pullAt
statement:
theorem mem_pullAt {x : Fin (n + 1)} {B : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} {i : Fin n} :
    i ∈ pullAt x B ↔ x.succAbove i ∈ B

name: Veles.JB.insert_map_pullAt
statement:
theorem insert_map_pullAt {x : Fin (n + 1)} {B : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} (hx : x ∈ B) :
    insert x ((pullAt x B).map (Fin.succAboveEmb x)) = B
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  simp only [mem_insert, mem_map, Fin.succAboveEmb_apply, mem_pullAt]
  constructor
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)
    · exact hx
    · exact hi
  · intro hj
    by_cases hjx : j = x
    · exact Or.inl hjx
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succAbove_eq hjx
      exact Or.inr ⟨i, hj, rfl⟩

name: Veles.JB.card_pullAt
statement:
theorem card_pullAt {x : Fin (n + 1)} {B : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} (hx : x ∈ B) :
    (pullAt x B).card + 1 = B.card
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← insert_map_pullAt hx]
  rw [card_insert_of_notMem, card_map]
  simp only [mem_map, Fin.succAboveEmb_apply, not_exists, not_and]
  intro i _ h; exact Fin.succAbove_ne x i h

name: Veles.JB.pullAt_inter
statement:
theorem pullAt_inter (x : Fin (n + 1)) (s t : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) :
    pullAt x (s ∩ t) = pullAt x s ∩ pullAt x t

name: Veles.JB.pullAt_injOn
statement:
theorem pullAt_injOn {x : Fin (n + 1)} {s t : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} (hs : x ∈ s) (ht : x ∈ t)
    (h : pullAt x s = pullAt x t) : s = t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← insert_map_pullAt hs, ← insert_map_pullAt ht, h]

name: Veles.JB.card_le_johnsonBound
statement:
theorem card_le_johnsonBound : ∀ (n w : ℕ) (I : Finset {s : Finset (Fin n) // s.card = w}),
    (J(n, w)).IsIndepSet (I : Set _) → I.card ≤ Erdos835.johnsonBound n 4 w
proof:
| 0, w, I, _ => by
    show I.card ≤ 1
    apply card_le_one.2
    intro a _ b _
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext i; exact i.elim0
  | n + 1, 0, I, _ => by
    show I.card ≤ 1
    apply card_le_one.2
    intro a _ b _
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [card_eq_zero.1 a.2, card_eq_zero.1 b.2]
  | n + 1, w + 1, I, hI => by
    show I.card ≤ if 2 * (w + 1) < 4 then 1 else (n + 1) * Erdos835.johnsonBound n 4 w / (w + 1)
    split_ifs with hw
    · 
      apply card_le_one.2
      intro a ha b hb
      by_contra hab
      apply hI ha hb hab
      rw [johnson_adj]
      have : w = 0 := by omega
      subst this
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := card_eq_one.1 a.2
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := card_eq_one.1 b.2
      have hpq : p ≠ q := by
        intro h; apply hab; apply Subtype.ext; rw [hp, hq, h]
      rw [hp, hq, singleton_inter_of_notMem (by simpa using hpq)]; simp
    · 
      rw [Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by omega)]
      
      let Ix : Fin (n + 1) → Finset {s : Finset (Fin n) // s.card = w} := fun x =>
        (I.filter (fun s => x ∈ s.val)).attach.image (fun s =>
          ⟨pullAt x s.1.val, by
            have := card_pullAt (mem_filter.1 s.2).2; rw [s.1.2] at this; omega⟩)
      have hIx : ∀ x, (Ix x).card = (I.filter (fun s => x ∈ s.val)).card := by
        intro x
        rw [card_image_of_injective, card_attach]
        intro a b h
        have h' : pullAt x a.1.val = pullAt x b.1.val := congrArg Subtype.val h
        exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext (pullAt_injOn (mem_filter.1 a.2).2 (mem_filter.1 b.2).2 h'))
      have hind : ∀ x, (J(n, w)).IsIndepSet (Ix x : Set _) := by
        intro x a ha b hb hab hadj
        simp only [Ix, coe_image, Set.mem_image, mem_coe, mem_attach, true_and] at ha hb
        obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := ha
        obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := hb
        have hne : a'.1 ≠ b'.1 := fun h =>
          hab (Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun s : {s : Finset (Fin (n + 1)) // s.card = w + 1} =>
            pullAt x s.val) h))
        apply hI (mem_filter.1 a'.2).1 (mem_filter.1 b'.2).1 hne
        rw [johnson_adj] at hadj ⊢
        simp only at hadj
        rw [← pullAt_inter] at hadj
        have := card_pullAt (mem_inter.2 ⟨(mem_filter.1 a'.2).2, (mem_filter.1 b'.2).2⟩)
        omega
      have hsum : ∑ x : Fin (n + 1), (I.filter (fun s => x ∈ s.val)).card = ∑ _s ∈ I, (w + 1) := by
        simp only [card_eq_sum_ones, sum_filter]
        rw [sum_comm]
        refine sum_congr rfl (fun s _ => ?_)
        rw [← sum_filter, ← card_eq_sum_ones, filter_mem_eq_inter, univ_inter, s.2]
      calc I.card * (w + 1) = ∑ x : Fin (n + 1), (Ix x).card := by
            rw [sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => hIx x), hsum, sum_const, smul_eq_mul]
        _ ≤ ∑ _x : Fin (n + 1), Erdos835.johnsonBound n 4 w :=
          sum_le_sum (fun x _ => card_le_johnsonBound n w (Ix x) (hind x))
        _ = (n + 1) * Erdos835.johnsonBound n 4 w := by simp

name: Veles.JB.indepNum_johnson_le_johnsonBound
statement:
theorem indepNum_johnson_le_johnsonBound {n k : ℕ} :
    (J(n, k)).indepNum ≤ Erdos835.johnsonBound n 4 k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (J(n, k)).exists_isNIndepSet_indepNum
  rw [← hs.card_eq]
  exact card_le_johnsonBound n k s hs.isIndepSet

name: Veles.J835.adj_of_subset
statement:
theorem adj_of_subset {A : Finset (Fin (2 * k))} (hA : A.card = k + 1) {s t : V k}
    (hs : s.val ⊆ A) (ht : t.val ⊆ A) (hst : s ≠ t) : J(2 * k, k).Adj s t
proof:
:= by
  rw [johnson_adj]
  have hne : s.val ≠ t.val := fun h => hst (Subtype.ext h)
  have hu : (s.val ∪ t.val).card ≤ k + 1 := hA ▸ card_le_card (union_subset hs ht)
  have hu' : k + 1 ≤ (s.val ∪ t.val).card := by
    by_contra hlt
    have h1 : (s.val ∪ t.val).card ≤ k := by omega
    have h2 : s.val ∪ t.val = s.val :=
      (eq_of_subset_of_card_le subset_union_left (by rw [s.2]; exact h1)).symm
    have h3 : s.val ∪ t.val = t.val :=
      (eq_of_subset_of_card_le subset_union_right (by rw [t.2]; exact h1)).symm
    exact hne (h2.symm.trans h3)
  have := card_union_add_card_inter s.val t.val
  rw [s.2, t.2] at this
  omega

name: Veles.J835.card_union_of_adj
statement: theorem card_union_of_adj {s t : V k} (h : J(2 * k, k).Adj s t) : (s.val ∪ t.val).card = k + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [johnson_adj] at h
  have := card_union_add_card_inter s.val t.val
  rw [s.2, t.2] at this
  omega

name: Veles.J835.card_subsOf
statement: theorem card_subsOf {A : Finset (Fin (2 * k))} (hA : A.card = k + 1) : (subsOf A).card = k + 1
proof:
:= by
  have : (subsOf A).map ⟨Subtype.val, Subtype.val_injective⟩ = A.powersetCard k := by
    ext u
    simp only [subsOf, mem_map, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk,
      mem_powersetCard]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩; exact ⟨hs.subset, s.2⟩
    · rintro ⟨hu, hc⟩
      refine ⟨⟨u, hc⟩, ssubset_of_subset_of_ne hu ?_, rfl⟩
      intro h
      have hu' : u = A := h
      rw [hu'] at hc; omega
  rw [← card_map, this, card_powersetCard, hA, Nat.choose_succ_self_right]

name: Veles.J835.property_iff_proper
statement:
theorem property_iff_proper (hk : 0 < k) :
    Erdos835.Property k ↔ ∃ c : V k → Fin (k + 1), ∀ s t, J(2 * k, k).Adj s t → c s ≠ c t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨c, fun s t hst => ?_⟩
    have hA := card_union_of_adj hst
    have himg := hc _ hA
    
    have hinj : Set.InjOn c (subsOf (s.val ∪ t.val) : Set (V k)) := by
      apply Finset.injOn_of_card_image_eq
      have : (subsOf (s.val ∪ t.val)).image c = univ := himg
      rw [this, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, card_subsOf hA]
    intro heq
    have hs : s ∈ subsOf (s.val ∪ t.val) := by
      simp only [subsOf, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
      refine ssubset_of_subset_of_ne subset_union_left (fun h => ?_)
      have := congrArg card h; rw [s.2, hA] at this; omega
    have ht : t ∈ subsOf (s.val ∪ t.val) := by
      simp only [subsOf, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
      refine ssubset_of_subset_of_ne subset_union_right (fun h => ?_)
      have := congrArg card h; rw [t.2, hA] at this; omega
    exact hst.ne (hinj hs ht heq)
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨c, fun A hA => ?_⟩
    apply eq_univ_of_card
    rw [Fintype.card_fin, card_image_of_injOn]
    · exact card_subsOf hA
    intro s hs t ht heq
    by_contra hne
    simp only [coe_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hs ht
    exact hc s t (adj_of_subset hA hs.subset ht.subset hne) heq

name: Veles.J835.clique_bound
statement: theorem clique_bound (hk : 0 < k) : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ J(2 * k, k).chromaticNumber
proof:
:= by
  
  let T : Finset (Fin (2 * k)) := univ.filter (fun i => i.val < k - 1)
  have hTc : T.card = k - 1 := by
    have : T = (range (k - 1)).attachFin (fun i hi => by
        have := mem_range.1 hi; omega) := by
      ext i; simp [T]
    rw [this, card_attachFin, card_range]
  let pt : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (2 * k) := fun j => ⟨k - 1 + j.val, by omega⟩
  have hpt : ∀ j, pt j ∉ T := fun j h => by simp [T, pt] at h
  let f : Fin (k + 1) → V k := fun j => ⟨insert (pt j) T, by rw [card_insert_of_notMem (hpt j), hTc]; omega⟩
  apply le_chromaticNumber_of_pairwise_adj (by simp) f
  intro i j hij
  have hij' : pt i ≠ pt j := fun h => hij (Fin.ext (by simpa [pt] using congrArg Fin.val h))
  refine adj_of_subset (A := insert (pt i) (insert (pt j) T)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [card_insert_of_notMem, card_insert_of_notMem (hpt j), hTc]
    · omega
    · simp only [mem_insert, not_or]; exact ⟨hij', hpt i⟩
  · intro x hx
    rcases mem_insert.1 hx with rfl | hx
    · exact mem_insert_self _ _
    · exact mem_insert_of_mem (mem_insert_of_mem hx)
  · intro x hx
    rcases mem_insert.1 hx with rfl | hx
    · exact mem_insert_of_mem (mem_insert_self _ _)
    · exact mem_insert_of_mem (mem_insert_of_mem hx)
  · intro h
    have : pt i ∈ insert (pt j) T := by
      have := congrArg Subtype.val h; simp only [f] at this; rw [← this]; exact mem_insert_self _ _
    rcases mem_insert.1 this with h' | h'
    · exact hij' h'
    · exact hpt i h'

name: Veles.J835.property_iff_chromaticNumber
statement:
theorem property_iff_chromaticNumber (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    J(2 * k, k).chromaticNumber = k + 1 ↔ Erdos835.Property k
proof:
:= by
  rw [property_iff_proper hk]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hc : J(2 * k, k).Colorable (k + 1) := by
      rw [← chromaticNumber_le_iff_colorable]; rw [h]; norm_cast
    obtain ⟨C⟩ := hc
    exact ⟨C, fun s t hst => C.valid hst⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    apply le_antisymm
    · have : J(2 * k, k).Colorable (k + 1) := ⟨Coloring.mk c (fun h => hc _ _ h)⟩
      exact_mod_cast this.chromaticNumber_le
    · exact_mod_cast clique_bound hk

name: Veles.J835.exists_unique_colour
statement:
theorem exists_unique_colour {c : V k → Fin (k + 1)}
    (hc : ∀ s t, J(2 * k, k).Adj s t → c s ≠ c t) (hk : 0 < k)
    (R : Finset (Fin (2 * k))) (hR : R.card = k - 1) (i : Fin (k + 1)) :
    (((univ.filter (fun s : V k => c s = i)).map ⟨Subtype.val, Subtype.val_injective⟩).filter
      (R ⊆ ·)).card = 1
proof:
:= by
  
  have hout : (univ \ R).card = k + 1 := by rw [card_sdiff_of_subset (subset_univ _), card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, hR]; omega
  let g : (univ \ R : Finset (Fin (2 * k))) → V k := fun x =>
    ⟨insert x.1 R, by rw [card_insert_of_notMem (mem_sdiff.1 x.2).2, hR]; omega⟩
  have hginj : Function.Injective g := by
    intro x y h
    have h' := congrArg Subtype.val h
    simp only [g] at h'
    have : x.1 ∈ insert y.1 R := h' ▸ mem_insert_self _ _
    rcases mem_insert.1 this with h1 | h1
    · exact Subtype.ext h1
    · exact absurd h1 (mem_sdiff.1 x.2).2
  
  have hcinj : Function.Injective (c ∘ g) := by
    intro x y hxy
    by_contra hne
    have hne' : g x ≠ g y := fun h => hne (hginj h)
    apply hc (g x) (g y) _ hxy
    rw [johnson_adj]
    have hx := (mem_sdiff.1 x.2).2
    have hy := (mem_sdiff.1 y.2).2
    have hxy' : x.1 ≠ y.1 := fun h => hne (Subtype.ext h)
    have : insert x.1 R ∩ insert y.1 R = R := by
      ext z; simp only [mem_inter, mem_insert]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h1 | h1, h2 | h2⟩
        · exact absurd (h1.symm.trans h2) hxy'
        · exact h2
        · exact h1
        · exact h1
      · intro h; exact ⟨Or.inr h, Or.inr h⟩
    simp only [g]; rw [this, hR]; omega
  have hbij : Function.Bijective (c ∘ g) := by
    rw [Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card]
    exact ⟨hcinj, by rw [Fintype.card_coe, hout, Fintype.card_fin]⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hu⟩ := hbij.existsUnique i
  rw [card_eq_one]
  refine ⟨(g x).val, ?_⟩
  ext B
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_map, mem_univ, true_and, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk, mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, hRs⟩
    
    have hc' : (s.val \ R).card = 1 := by rw [card_sdiff_of_subset hRs, s.2, hR]; omega
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := card_eq_one.1 hc'
    have hy' := mem_sdiff.1 (hy ▸ mem_singleton_self y)
    have hsy : s = g ⟨y, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_univ _, hy'.2⟩⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp only [g]
      ext z; simp only [mem_insert]
      constructor
      · intro hz
        by_cases hzR : z ∈ R
        · exact Or.inr hzR
        · left; have : z ∈ s.val \ R := mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hz, hzR⟩; rwa [hy, mem_singleton] at this
      · rintro (rfl | hz)
        · exact hy'.1
        · exact hRs hz
    have := hu ⟨y, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨mem_univ _, hy'.2⟩⟩ (by simp only [Function.comp_apply]; rw [← hsy]; exact hs)
    rw [hsy, this]
  · rintro rfl
    refine ⟨⟨g x, hx, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [g]; exact subset_insert _ _

name: Veles.J835.property_iff_largeSet
statement:
theorem property_iff_largeSet (hk : 0 < k) :
    Erdos835.Property k ↔ LargeSet (k - 1) k (2 * k) (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [property_iff_proper hk]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨fun i => ⟨(univ.filter (fun s : V k => c s = i)).map ⟨Subtype.val, Subtype.val_injective⟩,
      fun B hB => ?_, fun R hR => exists_unique_colour hc hk R hR i⟩, fun s hs => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨s, -, rfl⟩ := mem_map.1 hB; exact s.2
    · refine ⟨c ⟨s, hs⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [mem_map, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk]
        exact ⟨⟨s, hs⟩, rfl, rfl⟩
      · intro j hj
        simp only [mem_map, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk] at hj
        obtain ⟨u, hu, hus⟩ := hj
        have : u = ⟨s, hs⟩ := Subtype.ext hus
        rw [← hu, this]
  · rintro ⟨D, hD⟩
    classical
    let c : V k → Fin (k + 1) := fun s => (hD s.val s.2).choose
    refine ⟨c, fun s t hst heq => ?_⟩
    have hs := (hD s.val s.2).choose_spec.1
    have ht := (hD t.val t.2).choose_spec.1
    set i := c s
    have ht' : t.val ∈ (D i).blocks := heq ▸ ht
    
    have hR : (s.val ∩ t.val).card = k - 1 := by rw [johnson_adj] at hst; omega
    have h1 := (D i).cover_unique _ hR
    have hne : s.val ≠ t.val := fun h => hst.ne (Subtype.ext h)
    have h2 : 2 ≤ ((D i).blocks.filter ((s.val ∩ t.val) ⊆ ·)).card := by
      refine (card_pair hne).symm.le.trans (card_le_card ?_)
      intro B hB
      rcases mem_insert.1 hB with rfl | hB
      · exact mem_filter.2 ⟨hs, inter_subset_left⟩
      · rw [mem_singleton] at hB; subst hB; exact mem_filter.2 ⟨ht', inter_subset_right⟩
    omega

name: Veles.J835.steiner_of_property
statement:
theorem steiner_of_property (hk : 0 < k) (h : Erdos835.Property k) :
    Nonempty (SteinerSystem (k - 1) k (2 * k))

name: Veles.J835.not_dvd_descFactorial
statement:
theorem not_dvd_descFactorial {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpk : p ∣ k + 1) :
    ∀ j, j + 1 ≤ p → ¬ p ∣ (k + p).descFactorial j
proof:
| 0, _ => by rw [Nat.descFactorial_zero]; exact hp.not_dvd_one
  | j + 1, hj => by
    rw [Nat.descFactorial_succ]
    intro h
    rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hp).1 h with h1 | h1
    · 
      have e : k + p - j = (k + 1) + (p - 1 - j) := by omega
      rw [e] at h1
      have h3 : p ∣ p - 1 - j := (Nat.dvd_add_right hpk).1 h1
      have h4 : 0 < p - 1 - j := by omega
      exact absurd (Nat.le_of_dvd h4 h3) (by omega)
    · exact not_dvd_descFactorial hp hpk j (by omega) h1

name: Veles.J835.prime_of_steiner
statement:
theorem prime_of_steiner (hk : 0 < k) (h : Nonempty (SteinerSystem (k - 1) k (2 * k))) :
    (k + 1).Prime
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnp
  have h2 : 2 ≤ k + 1 := by omega
  set p := (k + 1).minFac
  have hp : p.Prime := Nat.minFac_prime (by omega)
  have hpk : p ∣ k + 1 := Nat.minFac_dvd _
  have hplt : p < k + 1 := by
    rcases (Nat.minFac_le (by omega : 0 < k + 1)).lt_or_eq with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd (h ▸ hp) hnp
  have hp2 := hp.two_le
  
  have hS := nonempty_iterate (by omega) (by omega) h (k - p) (by omega)
  have e1 : k - 1 - (k - p) = p - 1 := by omega
  have e2 : k - (k - p) = p := by omega
  have e3 : 2 * k - (k - p) = k + p := by omega
  rw [e1, e2, e3] at hS
  have hdvd := choose_dvd hS.some
  rw [show p.choose (p - 1) = p by
    rw [Nat.choose_symm_of_eq_add (by omega : p = (p - 1) + 1), Nat.choose_one_right]] at hdvd
  
  have : p ∣ (k + p).descFactorial (p - 1) := by
    rw [Nat.descFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose]; exact Dvd.dvd.mul_left hdvd _
  exact not_dvd_descFactorial hp hpk (p - 1) (by have := hp.one_lt; omega) this

name: Veles.J835.lt_chromaticNumber_of_not_prime
statement:
theorem lt_chromaticNumber_of_not_prime (hk : 0 < k) (h : ¬ (k + 1).Prime) :
    ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) < J(2 * k, k).chromaticNumber
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne (clique_bound hk) (fun heq => h ?_)
  exact prime_of_steiner hk (steiner_of_property hk ((property_iff_chromaticNumber k hk).1 (by
    rw [← heq]; norm_cast)))

name: Veles.J835.lt_chromaticNumber_of_odd
statement:
theorem lt_chromaticNumber_of_odd (hk : 2 < k) (h : Odd k) :
    ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) < J(2 * k, k).chromaticNumber
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_chromaticNumber_of_not_prime (by omega) (fun hp => ?_)
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := h
  have : 2 ∣ 2 * m + 1 + 1 := ⟨m + 1, by ring⟩
  rcases hp.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd 2 this with h2 | h2 <;> omega

name: Veles.Cert9.noExt_empty
statement: theorem noExt_empty : NoExt 9 4 ∅
proof:
:= by

name: Veles.Cover.mem_items_iff
statement:
theorem mem_items_iff {k : ℕ} {B T : Finset ℕ} (hB : B.card = k) :
    T ∈ items B ↔ T ⊆ B ∧ T.card + 1 = k
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨erase_subset _ _, by rw [card_erase_of_mem hy, ← hB]; have := card_pos.2 ⟨y, hy⟩; omega⟩
  · rintro ⟨hTB, hT⟩
    have hc : (B \ T).card = 1 := by rw [card_sdiff_of_subset hTB]; omega
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := card_eq_one.1 hc
    have hyB : y ∈ B := (mem_sdiff.1 (hy ▸ mem_singleton_self y)).1
    have hyT : y ∉ T := (mem_sdiff.1 (hy ▸ mem_singleton_self y)).2
    refine ⟨y, hyB, ?_⟩
    ext z
    simp only [mem_erase]
    constructor
    · intro hz; exact ⟨fun h => hyT (h ▸ hz), hTB hz⟩
    · rintro ⟨hzy, hzB⟩
      by_contra hzT
      have : z ∈ B \ T := mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzB, hzT⟩
      rw [hy, mem_singleton] at this
      exact hzy this

name: Veles.Cover.eq_insert_of_card
statement:
theorem eq_insert_of_card {k : ℕ} {B T : Finset ℕ} (hTB : T ⊆ B) (hB : B.card = k)
    (hT : T.card + 1 = k) : ∃ x ∈ B, x ∉ T ∧ B = insert x T
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (B \ T).card = 1 := by rw [card_sdiff_of_subset hTB]; omega
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := card_eq_one.1 hc
  have hx' := mem_sdiff.1 (hx ▸ mem_singleton_self x)
  refine ⟨x, hx'.1, hx'.2, ?_⟩
  ext z
  simp only [mem_insert]
  constructor
  · intro hz
    by_cases hzT : z ∈ T
    · exact Or.inr hzT
    · left
      have : z ∈ B \ T := mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hz, hzT⟩
      rwa [hx, mem_singleton] at this
  · rintro (rfl | hz)
    · exact hx'.1
    · exact hTB hz

name: Veles.Cover.noExt_branch
statement:
theorem noExt_branch {v k : ℕ} {X : Set (Finset ℕ)} {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : T ⊆ range v)
    (hTk : T.card + 1 = k) (hTX : T ∉ X)
    (h : ∀ x < v, x ∉ T → (∀ y ∈ insert x T, (insert x T).erase y ∉ X) →
      NoExt v k (X ∪ items (insert x T))) :
    NoExt v k X
proof:
:= by
  intro F hF
  obtain ⟨B, ⟨hBF, hTB⟩, huniq⟩ := (hF.2 T hT hTk).2 hTX
  obtain ⟨hBv, hBk⟩ := hF.1 B hBF
  obtain ⟨x, hxB, hxT, rfl⟩ := eq_insert_of_card hTB hBk hTk
  have hxv : x < v := mem_range.1 (hBv hxB)
  refine h x hxv hxT ?_ (F.erase (insert x T)) ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro y hy hyX
    have hsub : (insert x T).erase y ⊆ range v := (erase_subset _ _).trans hBv
    have hcard : ((insert x T).erase y).card + 1 = k := by
      rw [card_erase_of_mem hy, ← hBk]; have := card_pos.2 ⟨y, hy⟩; omega
    exact (hF.2 _ hsub hcard).1 hyX _ hBF (erase_subset _ _)
  · intro B' hB'
    exact hF.1 B' (mem_of_mem_erase hB')
  · intro T' hT' hT'k
    constructor
    · rintro (hX | hI) B' hB' hsub
      · exact (hF.2 T' hT' hT'k).1 hX B' (mem_of_mem_erase hB') hsub
      · by_cases hX : T' ∈ X
        · exact (hF.2 T' hT' hT'k).1 hX B' (mem_of_mem_erase hB') hsub
        · obtain ⟨_, _, hu⟩ := (hF.2 T' hT' hT'k).2 hX
          have h1 := hu B' ⟨mem_of_mem_erase hB', hsub⟩
          have h2 := hu (insert x T) ⟨hBF, ((mem_items_iff hBk).1 hI).1⟩
          exact (ne_of_mem_erase hB') (h1.trans h2.symm)
    · intro hnot
      have hX : T' ∉ X := fun h => hnot (Or.inl h)
      have hI : T' ∉ items (insert x T) := fun h => hnot (Or.inr h)
      obtain ⟨B'', ⟨hB''F, hB''⟩, hu⟩ := (hF.2 T' hT' hT'k).2 hX
      have hne : B'' ≠ insert x T := by
        rintro rfl; exact hI ((mem_items_iff hBk).2 ⟨hB'', hT'k⟩)
      refine ⟨B'', ⟨mem_erase.2 ⟨hne, hB''F⟩, hB''⟩, ?_⟩
      rintro B' ⟨hB'F, hB'⟩
      exact hu B' ⟨mem_of_mem_erase hB'F, hB'⟩

name: Veles.Cover.noExt_of_map
statement:
theorem noExt_of_map {v k : ℕ} {X Y : Set (Finset ℕ)} (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn f (range v)) (hmap : ∀ i < v, f i < v)
    (hXY : ∀ T ⊆ range v, T.card + 1 = k → (T ∈ X ↔ T.image f ∈ Y)) (hY : NoExt v k Y) :
    NoExt v k X
proof:
:= by
  intro F hF
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo f (range v : Set ℕ) (range v : Set ℕ) := fun i hi => by
    simp only [coe_range, Set.mem_Iio] at hi ⊢; exact hmap i hi
  have hsurj : Set.SurjOn f (range v : Set ℕ) (range v : Set ℕ) :=
    Finset.surjOn_of_injOn_of_card_le f hmaps hinj le_rfl
  
  have img_sub : ∀ {S : Finset ℕ}, S ⊆ range v → S.image f ⊆ range v := fun hS z hz => by
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hz
    exact mem_range.2 (hmap a (mem_range.1 (hS ha)))
  have img_card : ∀ {S : Finset ℕ}, S ⊆ range v → (S.image f).card = S.card := fun hS =>
    card_image_of_injOn (fun a ha b hb h => hinj (mem_coe.2 (hS ha)) (mem_coe.2 (hS hb)) h)
  have img_le : ∀ {S S' : Finset ℕ}, S ⊆ range v → S' ⊆ range v →
      (S.image f ⊆ S'.image f ↔ S ⊆ S') := fun hS hS' => by
    constructor
    · intro h z hz
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hwz⟩ := mem_image.1 (h (mem_image_of_mem f hz))
      have := hinj (mem_coe.2 (hS' hw)) (mem_coe.2 (hS hz)) hwz
      exact this ▸ hw
    · exact image_subset_image
  
  have preimg : ∀ {T' : Finset ℕ}, T' ⊆ range v →
      ∃ T ⊆ range v, T.image f = T' := fun {T'} hT' => by
    refine ⟨(range v).filter (fun i => f i ∈ T'), filter_subset _ _, ?_⟩
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hz
      exact (mem_filter.1 ha).2
    · intro hz
      obtain ⟨a, ha, haz⟩ := hsurj (mem_coe.2 (hT' hz))
      exact mem_image.2 ⟨a, mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_coe.1 ha, haz ▸ hz⟩, haz⟩
  apply hY (F.image (fun B => B.image f))
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro B' hB'
    obtain ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hB'
    obtain ⟨hBv, hBk⟩ := hF.1 B hB
    exact ⟨img_sub hBv, (img_card hBv).trans hBk⟩
  · intro T' hT' hT'k
    obtain ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩ := preimg hT'
    have hTk : T.card + 1 = k := (img_card hT) ▸ hT'k
    have hiff := hXY T hT hTk
    constructor
    · intro hY' B' hB' hsub
      obtain ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hB'
      exact (hF.2 T hT hTk).1 (hiff.2 hY') B hB ((img_le hT (hF.1 B hB).1).1 hsub)
    · intro hY'
      obtain ⟨B, ⟨hBF, hTB⟩, hu⟩ := (hF.2 T hT hTk).2 (fun h => hY' (hiff.1 h))
      refine ⟨B.image f, ⟨mem_image_of_mem _ hBF, image_subset_image hTB⟩, ?_⟩
      rintro B'' ⟨hB''F, hB''⟩
      obtain ⟨B₀, hB₀, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hB''F
      rw [hu B₀ ⟨hB₀, (img_le hT (hF.1 B₀ hB₀).1).1 hB''⟩]

name: Veles.Cover.isCover_of_steiner
statement:
theorem isCover_of_steiner {t k v : ℕ} (hk : t + 1 = k) (S : SteinerSystems.SteinerSystem t k v) :
    IsCover v k ∅ (S.blocks.image (fun B => B.map Fin.valEmbedding))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro B' hB'
    obtain ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hB'
    refine ⟨fun z hz => ?_, by rw [card_map]; exact S.block_card B hB⟩
    obtain ⟨a, -, rfl⟩ := mem_map.1 hz
    exact mem_range.2 a.isLt
  · intro T hT hTk
    refine ⟨fun h => absurd h (Set.notMem_empty T), fun _ => ?_⟩
    
    set R : Finset (Fin v) := univ.filter (fun a => a.val ∈ T) with hR
    have hRT : R.map Fin.valEmbedding = T := by
      ext z
      simp only [mem_map, hR, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Fin.valEmbedding_apply]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩; exact ha
      · intro hz; exact ⟨⟨z, mem_range.1 (hT hz)⟩, hz, rfl⟩
    have hRc : R.card = t := by
      have := congrArg card hRT; rw [card_map] at this; omega
    have h1 := S.cover_unique R hRc
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := card_eq_one.1 h1
    have hBmem : B ∈ S.blocks.filter (R ⊆ ·) := hB ▸ mem_singleton_self B
    rw [mem_filter] at hBmem
    refine ⟨B.map Fin.valEmbedding, ⟨mem_image_of_mem _ hBmem.1, hRT ▸ map_subset_map.2 hBmem.2⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro B'' ⟨hB''F, hB''⟩
    obtain ⟨B₀, hB₀, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hB''F
    have : R ⊆ B₀ := by rw [← hRT] at hB''; exact map_subset_map.1 hB''
    have hmem : B₀ ∈ S.blocks.filter (R ⊆ ·) := mem_filter.2 ⟨hB₀, this⟩
    rw [hB, mem_singleton] at hmem
    rw [hmem]

name: Veles.Checker.testBit_foldl_items
statement:
theorem testBit_foldl_items (B j : ℕ) :
    ∀ (L : List ℕ) (m : ℕ),
      (L.foldl (fun m y => if (B >>> y) % 2 = 1 then m ||| (1 <<< (B ^^^ (1 <<< y))) else m) m).testBit j
        = true ↔ m.testBit j = true ∨ ∃ y ∈ L, B.testBit y = true ∧ j = B ^^^ 2 ^ y
proof:
| [], m => by simp
  | y :: L, m => by
    rw [List.foldl_cons, testBit_foldl_items B j L]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [Nat.testBit_lor, one_shl, one_shl, Nat.testBit_two_pow]
      rw [bit_iff] at h
      simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, List.mem_cons]
      constructor
      · rintro ((h1 | h2) | ⟨z, hz, h3⟩)
        · exact Or.inl h1
        · exact Or.inr ⟨y, Or.inl rfl, h, h2.symm⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨z, Or.inr hz, h3⟩
      · rintro (h1 | ⟨z, rfl | hz, h3, h4⟩)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h1)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr h4.symm)
        · exact Or.inr ⟨z, hz, h3, h4⟩
    · rw [bit_iff] at h
      simp only [List.mem_cons]
      constructor
      · rintro (h1 | ⟨z, hz, h3⟩)
        · exact Or.inl h1
        · exact Or.inr ⟨z, Or.inr hz, h3⟩
      · rintro (h1 | ⟨z, rfl | hz, h3, h4⟩)
        · exact Or.inl h1
        · exact absurd h3 h
        · exact Or.inr ⟨z, hz, h3, h4⟩

proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_dec, itemsOf, testBit_foldl_items]
  simp only [Nat.zero_testBit, Bool.false_eq_true, false_or, List.mem_range, testBit_pm,
    decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, -, hy, h⟩
    exact ⟨y, hy, pm_injective (h.trans (pm_erase hy).symm)⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨y, mem_range.1 (hB hy), hy, pm_erase hy⟩

proof:
:= by

name: Veles.Checker.compat_iff
statement:
theorem compat_iff {v X : ℕ} {B : Finset ℕ} (hB : B ⊆ range v) :
    itemsOf v (pm B) &&& X = 0 ↔ ∀ y ∈ B, B.erase y ∉ dec X
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h y hy hX
    have h1 : B.erase y ∈ dec (itemsOf v (pm B)) := (mem_dec_itemsOf hB).2 ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    have : (itemsOf v (pm B) &&& X).testBit (pm (B.erase y)) = true := by
      rw [Nat.testBit_land]; exact Bool.and_eq_true_iff.2 ⟨h1, hX⟩
    rw [h, Nat.zero_testBit] at this; exact absurd this (by simp)
  · intro h
    apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq; intro j
    rw [Nat.testBit_land, Nat.zero_testBit]
    by_contra hne
    have hj : (itemsOf v (pm B)).testBit j = true ∧ X.testBit j = true := by
      simpa using hne
    have hT : ofMask j ∈ dec (itemsOf v (pm B)) := by rw [mem_dec, pm_ofMask]; exact hj.1
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyT⟩ := (mem_dec_itemsOf hB).1 hT
    exact h y hy (by rw [← hyT, mem_dec, pm_ofMask]; exact hj.2)

name: Veles.Checker.testBit_foldl_perm
statement:
theorem testBit_foldl_perm (σ : List ℕ) (m j : ℕ) :
    ∀ (L : List ℕ) (a : ℕ),
      (L.foldl (fun a y => if (m >>> y) % 2 = 1 then a ||| (1 <<< σ.getD y 0) else a) a).testBit j
        = true ↔ a.testBit j = true ∨ ∃ y ∈ L, m.testBit y = true ∧ j = σ.getD y 0
proof:
| [], a => by simp
  | y :: L, a => by
    rw [List.foldl_cons, testBit_foldl_perm σ m j L]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [Nat.testBit_lor, one_shl, Nat.testBit_two_pow]
      rw [bit_iff] at h
      simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, List.mem_cons]
      constructor
      · rintro ((h1 | h2) | ⟨z, hz, h3⟩)
        · exact Or.inl h1
        · exact Or.inr ⟨y, Or.inl rfl, h, h2.symm⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨z, Or.inr hz, h3⟩
      · rintro (h1 | ⟨z, rfl | hz, h3, h4⟩)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h1)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr h4.symm)
        · exact Or.inr ⟨z, hz, h3, h4⟩
    · rw [bit_iff] at h
      simp only [List.mem_cons]
      constructor
      · rintro (h1 | ⟨z, hz, h3⟩)
        · exact Or.inl h1
        · exact Or.inr ⟨z, Or.inr hz, h3⟩
      · rintro (h1 | ⟨z, rfl | hz, h3, h4⟩)
        · exact Or.inl h1
        · exact absurd h3 h
        · exact Or.inr ⟨z, hz, h3, h4⟩

name: Veles.Checker.permMask_pm
statement:
theorem permMask_pm {σ : List ℕ} {v : ℕ} {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : S ⊆ range v) :

proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq; intro j
  rw [testBit_pm]
  apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.2
  rw [permMask, testBit_foldl_perm]
  simp only [Nat.zero_testBit, Bool.false_eq_true, false_or, List.mem_range, testBit_pm,
    decide_eq_true_eq, mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, -, hy, rfl⟩; exact ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩; exact ⟨y, mem_range.1 (hS hy), hy, rfl⟩

name: Veles.Checker.validPerm_spec
statement:
theorem validPerm_spec {v : ℕ} {σ : List ℕ} (h : validPerm v σ = true) :
    Set.InjOn (fun i => σ.getD i 0) (range v) ∧ ∀ i < v, σ.getD i 0 < v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [validPerm, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, List.all_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
  obtain ⟨⟨hlen, hall⟩, hnd⟩ := h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a ha b hb hab
    simp only [coe_range, Set.mem_Iio] at ha hb
    simp only [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (hlen ▸ ha),
      List.getElem?_eq_getElem (hlen ▸ hb), Option.getD_some] at hab
    exact (List.Nodup.getElem_inj_iff hnd).1 hab
  · intro i hi
    simp only [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (hlen ▸ hi), Option.getD_some]
    exact hall _ (List.getElem_mem _)

name: Veles.Checker.testBit_permState
statement:
theorem testBit_permState (c : Ctx) (σ : List ℕ) (X j : ℕ) :
    ∀ (L : List ℕ) (a : ℕ),
      (L.foldl (fun a m => if (X >>> m) % 2 = 1 then a ||| (1 <<< permMask σ c.v m) else a) a).testBit j
        = true ↔ a.testBit j = true ∨ ∃ m ∈ L, X.testBit m = true ∧ j = permMask σ c.v m
proof:
| [], a => by simp
  | y :: L, a => by
    rw [List.foldl_cons, testBit_permState c σ X j L]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [Nat.testBit_lor, one_shl, Nat.testBit_two_pow]
      rw [bit_iff] at h
      simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, List.mem_cons]
      constructor
      · rintro ((h1 | h2) | ⟨z, hz, h3⟩)
        · exact Or.inl h1
        · exact Or.inr ⟨y, Or.inl rfl, h, h2.symm⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨z, Or.inr hz, h3⟩
      · rintro (h1 | ⟨z, rfl | hz, h3, h4⟩)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h1)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr h4.symm)
        · exact Or.inr ⟨z, hz, h3, h4⟩
    · rw [bit_iff] at h
      simp only [List.mem_cons]
      constructor
      · rintro (h1 | ⟨z, hz, h3⟩)
        · exact Or.inl h1
        · exact Or.inr ⟨z, Or.inr hz, h3⟩
      · rintro (h1 | ⟨z, rfl | hz, h3, h4⟩)
        · exact Or.inl h1
        · exact absurd h3 h
        · exact Or.inr ⟨z, hz, h3, h4⟩

name: Veles.Checker.reduceOk_sound
statement:
theorem reduceOk_sound {c : Ctx} (hc : c.Good) {X p j : ℕ} (h : reduceOk c X p j = true) :
    NoExt c.v (c.t + 1) (dec X)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [reduceOk, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
  obtain ⟨⟨hv, hj⟩, heq⟩ := h
  set σ := c.perms.getD p []
  obtain ⟨hinj, hmap⟩ := validPerm_spec hv
  refine noExt_of_map (fun i => σ.getD i 0) hinj hmap ?_ (heq ▸ hc.targets j hj)
  intro T hT hTk
  have hTc : T.card = c.t := by omega
  rw [mem_dec, mem_dec, permState, testBit_permState]
  simp only [Nat.zero_testBit, Bool.false_eq_true, false_or]
  constructor
  · intro hX
    exact ⟨pm T, hc.items_mem T hT hTc, hX, (permMask_pm hT).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨m, hm, hXm, hpm⟩
    have hmv := hc.items_lt m hm
    have hS := ofMask_subset_range hmv
    rw [← pm_ofMask m, permMask_pm hS] at hpm
    have himg := pm_injective hpm
    have : T = ofMask m := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · intro hz
        have : σ.getD z 0 ∈ (ofMask m).image (fun i => σ.getD i 0) := himg ▸ mem_image_of_mem _ hz
        obtain ⟨w, hw, hwz⟩ := mem_image.1 this
        have := hinj (mem_coe.2 (hS hw)) (mem_coe.2 (hT hz)) hwz
        exact this ▸ hw
      · intro hz
        have : σ.getD z 0 ∈ T.image (fun i => σ.getD i 0) := himg.symm ▸ mem_image_of_mem _ hz
        obtain ⟨w, hw, hwz⟩ := mem_image.1 this
        have := hinj (mem_coe.2 (hT hw)) (mem_coe.2 (hS hz)) hwz
        exact this ▸ hw
    rw [this, pm_ofMask]; exact hXm

name: Veles.Checker.sound
statement:
theorem sound (c : Ctx) (hc : c.Good) : ∀ f : ℕ,
    (∀ X s s', node c f X s = some s' → NoExt c.v (c.t + 1) (dec X)) ∧
    (∀ X T x s s', kids c f X T x s = some s' →
      ∀ x', x ≤ x' → x' < c.v → (T >>> x') % 2 = 0 → itemsOf c.v (T ||| (1 <<< x')) &&& X = 0 →
        NoExt c.v (c.t + 1) (dec (X ||| itemsOf c.v (T ||| (1 <<< x')))))
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  induction f with
  | zero => exact ⟨fun _ _ _ h => by simp [node] at h, fun _ _ _ _ _ h => by simp [kids] at h⟩
  | succ f ih =>
    obtain ⟨ihn, ihk⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro X s s' h
      rw [node] at h
      rcases hr : read s with _ | ⟨T, s1⟩
      · rw [hr] at h; simp at h
      rw [hr] at h
      simp only at h
      split_ifs at h with hT0 hTok
      · rcases hr2 : read s1 with _ | ⟨p, s2⟩
        · rw [hr2] at h; simp at h
        rw [hr2] at h; simp only at h
        rcases hr3 : read s2 with _ | ⟨j, s3⟩
        · rw [hr3] at h; simp at h
        rw [hr3] at h; simp only at h
        split_ifs at h with hok
        exact reduceOk_sound hc hok
      · obtain ⟨hTv, hTc, hTX⟩ := hTok
        have hsub := ofMask_subset_range hTv
        have hcard : (ofMask T).card = c.t := (popc_eq_card c.v T hTv).symm.trans hTc
        refine noExt_branch hsub (by omega) ?_ ?_
        · rw [mem_dec, pm_ofMask]; rw [bit_zero_iff] at hTX; simp [hTX]
        · intro x hx hxT hcompat
          have hxb : (T >>> x) % 2 = 0 := by
            rw [bit_zero_iff, ← pm_ofMask T, testBit_pm]; simpa using hxT
          have hB : insert x (ofMask T) ⊆ range c.v := insert_subset (mem_range.2 hx) hsub
          have hBm : T ||| (1 <<< x) = pm (insert x (ofMask T)) := by
            rw [pm_insert, pm_ofMask, one_shl]
          have hc' : itemsOf c.v (T ||| (1 <<< x)) &&& X = 0 := by
            rw [hBm, compat_iff hB]; exact hcompat
          have := ihk X T 0 s1 s' h x (Nat.zero_le _) hx hxb hc'
          rwa [hBm, dec_lor_itemsOf hB] at this
    · intro X T x s s' h x' hxx' hx'v hbit hcomp
      rw [kids] at h
      split_ifs at h with hxv hcond
      · rcases hn : node c f (X ||| itemsOf c.v (T ||| (1 <<< x))) s with _ | s1
        · rw [hn] at h; simp at h
        rw [hn] at h; simp only at h
        rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hxx' with rfl | hlt
        · exact ihn _ _ _ hn
        · exact ihk X T (x + 1) s1 s' h x' hlt hx'v hbit hcomp
      · rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hxx' with rfl | hlt
        · exact absurd ⟨hbit, hcomp⟩ hcond
        · exact ihk X T (x + 1) s s' h x' hlt hx'v hbit hcomp
      · omega

name: Veles.Checker.node_sound
statement:
theorem node_sound {c : Ctx} (hc : c.Good) {f X : ℕ} {s s' : St}
    (h : node c f X s = some s') : NoExt c.v (c.t + 1) (dec X)
proof:
:=
  (sound c hc f).1 X s s' h

name: Veles.Steiner.mem_pull
statement: theorem mem_pull {B : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} {i : Fin n} : i ∈ pull B ↔ i.castSucc ∈ B

name: Veles.Steiner.lift_pull
statement: theorem lift_pull {B : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} (h : Fin.last n ∈ B) : lift (pull B) = B
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  simp only [lift, mem_insert, mem_map, Fin.castSuccEmb_apply, mem_pull]
  constructor
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)
    · exact h
    · exact hi
  · intro hj
    by_cases hl : j = Fin.last n
    · exact Or.inl hl
    · right
      exact ⟨j.castPred hl, by simpa using hj, by simp⟩

name: Veles.Steiner.pull_lift
statement: theorem pull_lift (R : Finset (Fin n)) : pull (lift R) = R
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [mem_pull, lift, mem_insert, mem_map, Fin.castSuccEmb_apply]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | ⟨j, hj, hji⟩)
    · exact absurd h (Fin.castSucc_ne_last i)
    · rwa [← Fin.castSucc_injective _ hji]
  · intro hi; exact Or.inr ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩

name: Veles.Steiner.card_lift
statement: theorem card_lift (R : Finset (Fin n)) : (lift R).card = R.card + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [lift, card_insert_of_notMem, card_map]
  simp only [mem_map, Fin.castSuccEmb_apply, not_exists, not_and]
  intro i _ h; exact Fin.castSucc_ne_last i h

name: Veles.Steiner.lift_subset_iff
statement:
theorem lift_subset_iff {R : Finset (Fin n)} {B : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} :
    lift R ⊆ B ↔ Fin.last n ∈ B ∧ R ⊆ pull B
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨h (mem_insert_self _ _), fun i hi => mem_pull.2 (h ?_)⟩
    exact mem_insert_of_mem (mem_map_of_mem _ hi)
  · rintro ⟨hl, hR⟩ j hj
    rcases mem_insert.1 hj with rfl | hj
    · exact hl
    · obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := mem_map.1 hj
      exact mem_pull.1 (hR hi)

name: Veles.Steiner.nonempty_derived
statement:
theorem nonempty_derived {t k m : ℕ} (ht : 0 < t) (hk : 0 < k) (hm : 0 < m)
    (h : Nonempty (SteinerSystem t k m)) : Nonempty (SteinerSystem (t - 1) (k - 1) (m - 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = t' + 1 := ⟨t - 1, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k', k = k' + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m', m = m' + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
  exact ⟨derived h.some⟩

name: Veles.Steiner.nonempty_iterate
statement:
theorem nonempty_iterate {t k m : ℕ} (htk : t ≤ k) (hkm : k ≤ m)
    (h : Nonempty (SteinerSystem t k m)) :
    ∀ d ≤ t, Nonempty (SteinerSystem (t - d) (k - d) (m - d))
proof:
| 0, _ => by simpa using h
  | d + 1, hd => by
    have := nonempty_derived (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (nonempty_iterate htk hkm h d (by omega))
    have e1 : t - d - 1 = t - (d + 1) := by omega
    have e2 : k - d - 1 = k - (d + 1) := by omega
    have e3 : m - d - 1 = m - (d + 1) := by omega
    rwa [e1, e2, e3] at this

name: Veles.Steiner.card_blocks_mul
statement:
theorem card_blocks_mul {t k m : ℕ} (S : SteinerSystem t k m) :
    S.blocks.card * k.choose t = m.choose t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h1 : ∑ R ∈ (univ : Finset (Fin m)).powersetCard t, (S.blocks.filter (R ⊆ ·)).card =
      m.choose t := by
    rw [sum_congr rfl (fun R hR => S.cover_unique R (mem_powersetCard.1 hR).2)]
    simp [card_powersetCard]
  have h2 : ∑ R ∈ (univ : Finset (Fin m)).powersetCard t, (S.blocks.filter (R ⊆ ·)).card =
      ∑ B ∈ S.blocks, (B.powersetCard t).card := by
    simp only [card_eq_sum_ones, sum_filter]
    rw [sum_comm]
    refine sum_congr rfl (fun B _ => ?_)
    rw [← sum_filter]
    congr 1
    ext R
    simp [mem_powersetCard, and_comm]
  rw [← h1, h2, sum_congr rfl (fun B hB => by rw [card_powersetCard, S.block_card B hB]),
    sum_const, smul_eq_mul]

name: Veles.Steiner.choose_dvd
statement: theorem choose_dvd {t k m : ℕ} (S : SteinerSystem t k m) : k.choose t ∣ m.choose t

name: Veles.Steiner.LargeSet.derived
statement:
theorem LargeSet.derived {t k m : ℕ} (h : LargeSet (t + 1) (k + 1) (n + 1) m) :
    LargeSet t k n m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := h
  refine ⟨fun i => Veles.Steiner.derived (D i), fun s hs => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hu⟩ := hD (lift s) (by rw [card_lift, hs])
  have mem_iff : ∀ j, s ∈ (Veles.Steiner.derived (D j)).blocks ↔ lift s ∈ (D j).blocks := by
    intro j
    simp only [Veles.Steiner.derived, mem_image, mem_filter]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨B, ⟨hB, hl⟩, rfl⟩; rwa [lift_pull hl]
    · intro h
      exact ⟨lift s, ⟨h, mem_insert_self _ _⟩, pull_lift s⟩
  exact ⟨i, (mem_iff i).2 hi, fun j hj => hu j ((mem_iff j).1 hj)⟩

name: Veles.CertKit.ofMask_eq_empty
statement: theorem ofMask_eq_empty {m : ℕ} : ofMask m = ∅ ↔ m = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; rw [← pm_ofMask m, h]; rfl
  · rintro rfl; rfl

name: Veles.CertKit.ofMask_or_two_pow
statement:
theorem ofMask_or_two_pow {a v : ℕ} (ha : a < 2 ^ v) :
    ofMask (a ||| (1 <<< v)) = insert v (ofMask a)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  rw [mem_insert, mem_ofMask, mem_ofMask, Nat.testBit_lor, one_shl, Nat.testBit_two_pow]
  by_cases h : i = v
  · subst h; simp
  · simp [h, Ne.symm h]

name: Veles.CertKit.mem_combs
statement: theorem mem_combs : ∀ (v t m : ℕ), m ∈ combs v t ↔ m < 2 ^ v ∧ (ofMask m).card = t
proof:
| 0, 0, m => by
    simp only [combs, List.mem_singleton, pow_zero, Nat.lt_one_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro rfl; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨rfl, -⟩; rfl
  | 0, t + 1, m => by
    simp only [combs, List.not_mem_nil, pow_zero, Nat.lt_one_iff, false_iff, not_and]
    rintro rfl; simp [ofMask]
  | v + 1, 0, m => by
    simp only [combs, List.mem_singleton, card_eq_zero, ofMask_eq_empty]
    constructor
    · rintro rfl; exact ⟨by positivity, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨-, rfl⟩; rfl
  | v + 1, t + 1, m => by
    rw [combs, List.mem_append, List.mem_map, mem_combs v (t + 1) m]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨hm, hc⟩ | ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩)
      · exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hm (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)), hc⟩
      · obtain ⟨ha1, ha2⟩ := (mem_combs v t a).1 ha
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [← pm_ofMask (a ||| _), ofMask_or_two_pow ha1]
          apply pm_lt
          intro i hi
          rcases mem_insert.1 hi with rfl | hi
          · exact mem_range.2 (by omega)
          · exact mem_range.2 (by have := mem_range.1 (ofMask_subset_range ha1 hi); omega)
        · rw [ofMask_or_two_pow ha1, card_insert_of_notMem, ha2]
          intro hv; have := mem_range.1 (ofMask_subset_range ha1 hv); omega
    · rintro ⟨hm, hc⟩
      by_cases hv : m.testBit v = true
      · right
        refine ⟨m % 2 ^ v, (mem_combs v t _).2 ⟨Nat.mod_lt _ (by positivity), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · have hsplit : ofMask m = insert v (ofMask (m % 2 ^ v)) := by
            ext i
            rw [mem_insert, mem_ofMask, mem_ofMask, Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow]
            by_cases h : i = v
            · subst h; simp [hv]
            · rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne h with h' | h'
              · simp [h, h']
              · have : m.testBit i = false :=
                  Nat.testBit_lt_two_pow (lt_of_lt_of_le hm (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) h'))
                simp [h, this, Nat.not_lt.2 h'.le]
          have hnot : v ∉ ofMask (m % 2 ^ v) := by
            rw [mem_ofMask, Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow]; simp
          rw [hsplit, card_insert_of_notMem hnot] at hc; omega
        · apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq; intro i
          rw [Nat.testBit_lor, one_shl, Nat.testBit_two_pow, Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow]
          by_cases h : i = v
          · subst h; simp [hv]
          · rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne h with h' | h'
            · simp [h, h', Ne.symm h]
            · have : m.testBit i = false :=
                Nat.testBit_lt_two_pow (lt_of_lt_of_le hm (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) h'))
              simp [h, this, Nat.not_lt.2 h'.le, Ne.symm h]
      · left
        refine ⟨Nat.lt_pow_two_of_testBit m (fun i hi => ?_), hc⟩
        rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hi with rfl | hi
        · simpa using hv
        · exact Nat.testBit_lt_two_pow (lt_of_lt_of_le hm (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hi))

name: Veles.CertKit.combs_good
statement:
theorem combs_good (v t : ℕ) : ItemsGood v t (combs v t) where
  mem S hS hc
proof:
:= (mem_combs v t (pm S)).2 ⟨pm_lt hS, by rw [ofMask_pm, hc]⟩
  lt m hm := ((mem_combs v t m).1 hm).1

name: Veles.Bridge.witness_of_property
statement:
theorem witness_of_property {k : ℕ} (hk7 : 7 ≤ k) (hk : k ≤ 192) (h : Erdos835.Property k) :
    Nonempty LargeSteinerSystemWitness
proof:
:= by
  have hS := steiner_of_property (by omega) h
  have hd : depth k ≤ k - 1 := by unfold depth; split_ifs <;> omega
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := nonempty_iterate (by omega) (by omega) hS (depth k) hd
  refine ⟨⟨2 * k - depth k, k - depth k, k - 1 - depth k, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, S⟩⟩ <;>
    (unfold depth; split_ifs <;> omega)

name: Veles.Bridge.steiner_4_5_of_property
statement:
theorem steiner_4_5_of_property {k : ℕ} (hk : 5 ≤ k) (h : Erdos835.Property k) :
    Nonempty (SteinerSystem 4 5 (k + 5))
proof:
:= by
  have hS := steiner_of_property (by omega) h
  have := nonempty_iterate (by omega) (by omega) hS (k - 5) (by omega)
  have e1 : k - 1 - (k - 5) = 4 := by omega
  have e2 : k - (k - 5) = 5 := by omega
  have e3 : 2 * k - (k - 5) = k + 5 := by omega
  rwa [e1, e2, e3] at this

name: Veles.Bridge.steiner_4_5_21_of_property_16
statement:
theorem steiner_4_5_21_of_property_16 (h : Erdos835.Property 16) :
    Nonempty (SteinerSystem 4 5 21)

name: Veles.Bridge.range_exact
statement:
theorem range_exact (k : ℕ) :
    ((∃ d < k - 1, 6 ≤ k - 1 - d ∧ k - 1 - d ≤ 9 ∧ 2 * k - d < 200) ↔ (7 ≤ k ∧ k ≤ 192))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨d, hd, h1, h2, h3⟩; omega
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨depth k, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> (unfold depth; split_ifs <;> omega)

name: Veles.Sym.surjective_of_proper
statement:
theorem surjective_of_proper (hk : 0 < k) {c : V k → Fin (k + 1)}
    (hc : ∀ s t, J(2 * k, k).Adj s t → c s ≠ c t) : Function.Surjective c
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  let R : Finset (Fin (2 * k)) := univ.filter (fun a => a.val < k - 1)
  have hR : R.card = k - 1 := by
    have : R = (range (k - 1)).attachFin (fun j hj => by have := mem_range.1 hj; omega) := by
      ext a; simp [R]
    rw [this, card_attachFin, card_range]
  have h := exists_unique_colour hc hk R hR i
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := card_pos.1 (by rw [h]; norm_num)
  have := (mem_filter.1 hB).1
  obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := mem_map.1 this
  exact ⟨s, (mem_filter.1 hs).2⟩

name: Veles.Sym.no_invariant_colouring
statement:
theorem no_invariant_colouring (hk : 0 < k) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (h1 : k + 1 < p)
    (h2 : p ≤ 2 * k) (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin (2 * k))) (hg : orderOf g = p)
    (c : V k → Fin (k + 1)) (hc : ∀ s t, J(2 * k, k).Adj s t → c s ≠ c t)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (k + 1))) (hinv : ∀ B, c (act g B) = σ (c B)) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hact_pow : ∀ n B, c (⟨B.val.map (g ^ n).toEmbedding, by rw [card_map]; exact B.2⟩ : V k)
      = (σ ^ n) (c B) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro B
      have e : (⟨B.val.map (g ^ 0).toEmbedding, by rw [card_map]; exact B.2⟩ : V k) = B := by
        apply Subtype.ext; ext a; simp [Equiv.Perm.one_symm]
      rw [e]; rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      intro B
      have e : (⟨B.val.map (g ^ (n + 1)).toEmbedding, by rw [card_map]; exact B.2⟩ : V k) =
          act g ⟨B.val.map (g ^ n).toEmbedding, by rw [card_map]; exact B.2⟩ := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        ext a
        simp only [act, Finset.mem_map, Equiv.toEmbedding_apply, pow_succ', Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩; exact ⟨(g ^ n) b, ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        · rintro ⟨_, ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
      rw [e, hinv, ih, pow_succ', Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
  have hgp : g ^ p = 1 := hg ▸ pow_orderOf_eq_one g
  have hσp : σ ^ p = 1 := by
    apply Equiv.ext; intro i
    obtain ⟨B, rfl⟩ := surjective_of_proper hk hc i
    have h := hact_pow p B
    have e : (⟨B.val.map (g ^ p).toEmbedding, by rw [card_map]; exact B.2⟩ : V k) = B := by
      apply Subtype.ext; ext a; simp [hgp, Equiv.Perm.one_symm]
    rw [e] at h
    simp only [Equiv.Perm.one_apply]; exact h.symm
  have hσ1 : σ = 1 := by
    have hdvd : orderOf σ ∣ p := orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one hσp
    rcases (Nat.dvd_prime hp).1 hdvd with h | h
    · exact orderOf_eq_one_iff.1 h
    · exfalso
      have : p ∣ (k + 1).factorial := by
        rw [← h, show (k + 1).factorial = Fintype.card (Equiv.Perm (Fin (k + 1))) by
          rw [Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_fin]]
        exact orderOf_dvd_card
      rw [hp.dvd_factorial] at this; omega
  subst hσ1
  
  have hcyc : g.IsCycle := Equiv.Perm.isCycle_of_prime_order' (hg ▸ hp)
    (by rw [Fintype.card_fin, hg]; omega)
  have hsupp : g.support.card = p := by rw [← hcyc.orderOf, hg]
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, g x ≠ x := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx, -⟩ := hcyc; exact ⟨x, hx⟩
  
  have hinj : ∀ i j, i < p → j < p → (g ^ i) x = (g ^ j) x → i = j := by
    intro i j hi hj h
    by_contra hne
    rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hij | hij
    · have e : (g ^ j) x = (g ^ i) ((g ^ (j - i)) x) := by
        rw [← Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, ← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hij.le]
      rw [e] at h
      have h' : (g ^ (j - i)) x = x := ((g ^ i).injective h).symm
      have h1 : g ^ (j - i) = 1 := (hcyc.pow_eq_one_iff' hx).2 h'
      have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (hg ▸ orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one h1)
      omega
    · have e : (g ^ i) x = (g ^ j) ((g ^ (i - j)) x) := by
        rw [← Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, ← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hij.le]
      rw [e] at h
      have h' : (g ^ (i - j)) x = x := (g ^ j).injective h
      have h1 : g ^ (i - j) = 1 := (hcyc.pow_eq_one_iff' hx).2 h'
      have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (hg ▸ orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one h1)
      omega
  
  set F : Finset (Fin (2 * k)) := univ.filter (fun y => g y = y) with hF
  have hFc : F.card = 2 * k - p := by
    have := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := (univ : Finset (Fin (2 * k))))
      (fun y => g y = y)
    have hs : univ.filter (fun y => ¬ g y = y) = g.support := by
      ext y; simp [Equiv.Perm.mem_support]
    rw [hs, hsupp, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at this
    rw [hF]; omega
  set a := p - k with ha
  let arc : ℕ → Fin (2 * k) := fun i => (g ^ i) x
  have harc_moved : ∀ i, g (arc i) ≠ arc i := fun i =>
    Equiv.Perm.mem_support.1 (Equiv.Perm.pow_apply_mem_support.2 (Equiv.Perm.mem_support.2 hx))
  have hinjOn : ∀ n, n ≤ p → Set.InjOn arc (range n : Set ℕ) := fun n hn i hi j hj h =>
    hinj i j (by simp at hi; omega) (by simp at hj; omega) h
  set A := (range a).image arc with hA
  set A1 := (range (a + 1)).image arc with hA1
  have hAc : A.card = a := by rw [hA, card_image_of_injOn (hinjOn a (by omega)), card_range]
  have hA1c : A1.card = a + 1 := by
    rw [hA1, card_image_of_injOn (hinjOn (a + 1) (by omega)), card_range]
  have hgA : A.map g.toEmbedding = (range a).image (fun i => arc (i + 1)) := by
    ext z
    simp only [hA, mem_map, mem_image, mem_range, Equiv.toEmbedding_apply, arc]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨w, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨i, hi, by rw [pow_succ', Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨(g ^ i) x, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, by rw [pow_succ', Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]⟩
  have hunion : A ∪ A.map g.toEmbedding = A1 := by
    rw [hgA]
    ext z
    simp only [hA, hA1, mem_union, mem_image, mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)
      · exact ⟨i, by omega, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨i + 1, by omega, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i a with h | h
      · exact Or.inl ⟨i, h, rfl⟩
      · right
        refine ⟨i - 1, by omega, ?_⟩
        have hi1 : i - 1 + 1 = i := by
          have : 1 ≤ i := by omega
          omega
        rw [hi1]
  have hFdisj : ∀ z ∈ F, ∀ i, z ≠ arc i := by
    intro z hz i h
    rw [hF, mem_filter] at hz
    exact harc_moved i (h ▸ hz.2)
  have hdisjA : Disjoint F A := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro z hz hzA
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hzA
    exact hFdisj _ hz i rfl
  have hdisjA1 : Disjoint F A1 := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro z hz hzA
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hzA
    exact hFdisj _ hz i rfl
  have hmapF : F.map g.toEmbedding = F := by
    ext z
    simp only [hF, mem_map, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Equiv.toEmbedding_apply]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩; rw [hw, hw]
    · intro hz; exact ⟨z, hz, hz⟩
  have hBc : (F ∪ A).card = k := by rw [card_union_of_disjoint hdisjA, hFc, hAc]; omega
  set B : V k := ⟨F ∪ A, hBc⟩
  have hgB : (act g B).val = F ∪ A.map g.toEmbedding := by
    simp only [act, B, map_union, hmapF]
  have hcup : ((act g B).val ∪ B.val).card = k + 1 := by
    rw [hgB]
    have : F ∪ A.map g.toEmbedding ∪ (F ∪ A) = F ∪ A1 := by
      rw [← hunion]; ext z; simp only [mem_union]; tauto
    rw [this, card_union_of_disjoint hdisjA1, hFc, hA1c]; omega
  have hadj : J(2 * k, k).Adj B (act g B) := by
    rw [johnson_adj]
    have := card_union_add_card_inter (act g B).val B.val
    rw [hcup, (act g B).2, B.2, inter_comm] at this
    omega
  exact hc B (act g B) hadj (by rw [hinv]; rfl)

name: Veles.Sym.no_invariant_colouring_16
statement:
theorem no_invariant_colouring_16 {p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ ({19, 23, 29, 31} : Finset ℕ))
    (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin (2 * 16))) (hg : orderOf g = p)
    (c : V 16 → Fin (16 + 1)) (hc : ∀ s t, J(2 * 16, 16).Adj s t → c s ≠ c t)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (16 + 1))) (hinv : ∀ B, c (act g B) = σ (c B)) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hpp : p.Prime := by
    simp only [mem_insert, mem_singleton] at hp
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
  have hr : 16 + 1 < p ∧ p ≤ 2 * 16 := by
    simp only [mem_insert, mem_singleton] at hp
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
  exact no_invariant_colouring (by norm_num) hpp hr.1 hr.2 g hg c hc σ hinv

name: Veles.LSC.testBit_foldl_or
statement:
theorem testBit_foldl_or (j : ℕ) : ∀ (L : List ℕ) (a : ℕ),
    (L.foldl (fun a T => a ||| (1 <<< T)) a).testBit j = true ↔ a.testBit j = true ∨ j ∈ L
proof:
| [], a => by simp
  | T :: L, a => by
    rw [List.foldl_cons, testBit_foldl_or j L, Nat.testBit_lor, one_shl, Nat.testBit_two_pow]
    simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, List.mem_cons]
    constructor
    · rintro ((h | h) | h)
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h.symm)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
    · rintro (h | h | h)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr h.symm)
      · exact Or.inr h

name: Veles.LSC.hi_pm
statement:
theorem hi_pm {n m : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : T ⊆ range (n + m)) :
    hi n m (pm T) = (colours n T).card
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : hi n m (pm T) = ((range m).filter (fun c => n + c ∈ T)).card := by
    rw [hi]
    have : ((range m).filter (fun c => n + c ∈ T)) =
        ((List.range m).filter (fun c => (pm T >>> (n + c)) % 2 = 1)).toFinset := by
      ext c; simp [bit_iff, testBit_pm]
    rw [this, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup ((List.nodup_range).filter _)]
  rw [h1]
  have : colours n T = ((range m).filter (fun c => n + c ∈ T)).map (addLeftEmbedding n) := by
    ext i
    simp only [colours, mem_filter, mem_map, mem_range, addLeftEmbedding_apply]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hi, hni⟩
      have := mem_range.1 (hT hi)
      exact ⟨i - n, ⟨by omega, by rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' hni]⟩, by omega⟩
    · rintro ⟨c, ⟨-, hc⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨hc, by omega⟩
  rw [this, card_map]

name: Veles.LSC.mem_dec_preOf
statement:
theorem mem_dec_preOf {n m k : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : T ⊆ range (n + m)) (hk : T.card = k) :
    T ∈ dec (preOf n m k) ↔ 2 ≤ (colours n T).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_dec, preOf, testBit_foldl_or]
  simp only [Nat.zero_testBit, Bool.false_eq_true, false_or, List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, h⟩; rwa [hi_pm hT] at h
  · intro h
    exact ⟨(combs_good (n + m) k).mem T hT hk, by rwa [hi_pm hT]⟩

name: Veles.LSC.colours_blk
statement:
theorem colours_blk {n m : ℕ} (c : Fin m) (B : Finset (Fin n)) :
    colours n (blk n c B) = {n + c.val}
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [colours, blk, mem_filter, mem_insert, mem_map, Fin.valEmbedding_apply, mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨rfl | ⟨a, -, rfl⟩, h⟩
    · rfl
    · exact absurd a.isLt (by omega)
  · rintro rfl; exact ⟨Or.inl rfl, by omega⟩

name: Veles.LSC.map_toFin
statement:
theorem map_toFin {n : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : ∀ i ∈ T, i < n) :
    (toFin n T).map Fin.valEmbedding = T
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [toFin, mem_map, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Fin.valEmbedding_apply]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩; exact ha
  · intro hi; exact ⟨⟨i, hT i hi⟩, hi, rfl⟩

name: Veles.LSC.subset_blk_iff
statement:
theorem subset_blk_iff {n m : ℕ} {c : Fin m} {B : Finset (Fin n)} {T : Finset ℕ}
    (hT : ∀ i ∈ T, i < n) : T ⊆ blk n c B ↔ toFin n T ⊆ B
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha
    simp only [toFin, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at ha
    rcases mem_insert.1 (h ha) with h1 | h1
    · have := a.isLt; omega
    · obtain ⟨b, hb, hba⟩ := mem_map.1 h1
      have hba' : b = a := Fin.ext (by simpa using hba)
      rwa [hba'] at hb
  · intro h i hi
    apply mem_insert_of_mem
    exact mem_map.2 ⟨⟨i, hT i hi⟩, h (by simp [toFin, hi]), rfl⟩

name: Veles.LSC.isCover_of_largeSet
statement:
theorem isCover_of_largeSet {k n m : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (h : LargeSet (k - 1) k n m) :
    ∃ F, IsCover (n + m) (k + 1) (dec (preOf n m k)) F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := h
  refine ⟨univ.biUnion (fun c : Fin m => (D c).blocks.image (blk n c)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro B' hB'
    simp only [mem_biUnion, mem_univ, true_and, mem_image] at hB'
    obtain ⟨c, B, hB, rfl⟩ := hB'
    refine ⟨fun i hi => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases mem_insert.1 hi with rfl | hi
      · exact mem_range.2 (by have := c.isLt; omega)
      · obtain ⟨a, -, rfl⟩ := mem_map.1 hi; exact mem_range.2 (by have := a.isLt; simp; omega)
    · rw [blk, card_insert_of_notMem, card_map, (D c).block_card B hB]
      simp only [mem_map, Fin.valEmbedding_apply, not_exists, not_and]
      intro a _ h; have := a.isLt; omega
  · intro T hT hTk
    have hTk' : T.card = k := by omega
    constructor
    · intro hX B' hB' hsub
      rw [mem_dec_preOf hT hTk'] at hX
      simp only [mem_biUnion, mem_univ, true_and, mem_image] at hB'
      obtain ⟨c, B, -, rfl⟩ := hB'
      have := card_le_card (filter_subset_filter (n ≤ ·) hsub)
      rw [← colours, ← colours, colours_blk, card_singleton] at this
      omega
    · intro hX
      rw [mem_dec_preOf hT hTk'] at hX
      have hle : (colours n T).card ≤ 1 := by omega
      rcases Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.1 hle with h0 | h1
      · 
        have hTn : ∀ i ∈ T, i < n := by
          intro i hi
          by_contra hni
          have : i ∈ colours n T := mem_filter.2 ⟨hi, by omega⟩
          rw [card_eq_zero.1 h0] at this; simp at this
        have hcard : (toFin n T).card = k := by
          rw [← card_map Fin.valEmbedding, map_toFin hTn, hTk']
        obtain ⟨c, hc, hu⟩ := hD _ hcard
        refine ⟨blk n c (toFin n T), ⟨?_, (subset_blk_iff hTn).2 subset_rfl⟩, ?_⟩
        · simp only [mem_biUnion, mem_univ, true_and, mem_image]; exact ⟨c, _, hc, rfl⟩
        · rintro B' ⟨hB', hsub⟩
          simp only [mem_biUnion, mem_univ, true_and, mem_image] at hB'
          obtain ⟨c', B, hB, rfl⟩ := hB'
          have hTB := (subset_blk_iff hTn).1 hsub
          have hEq : toFin n T = B :=
            eq_of_subset_of_card_le hTB (by rw [(D c').block_card B hB, hcard])
          subst hEq
          rw [hu c' hB]
      · 
        obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := card_eq_one.1 h1
        have hpT : p ∈ T := (mem_filter.1 (hp ▸ mem_singleton_self p : p ∈ colours n T)).1
        have hpn : n ≤ p := (mem_filter.1 (hp ▸ mem_singleton_self p : p ∈ colours n T)).2
        have hpm : p < n + m := mem_range.1 (hT hpT)
        set c : Fin m := ⟨p - n, by omega⟩
        set R := T.erase p
        have hRn : ∀ i ∈ R, i < n := by
          intro i hi
          by_contra hni
          have hic : i ∈ colours n T := mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_of_mem_erase hi, by omega⟩
          rw [hp, mem_singleton] at hic
          exact (ne_of_mem_erase hi) hic
        have hRc : (toFin n R).card = k - 1 := by
          rw [← card_map Fin.valEmbedding, map_toFin hRn, card_erase_of_mem hpT, hTk']
        have hTeq : ∀ B : Finset (Fin n), T ⊆ blk n c B ↔ toFin n R ⊆ B := by
          intro B
          constructor
          · intro hsub
            apply (subset_blk_iff (c := c) hRn).1
            exact (erase_subset _ _).trans hsub
          · intro hsub i hi
            by_cases hip : i = p
            · subst hip; simp only [blk, c]; apply mem_insert.2; left; omega
            · exact (subset_blk_iff (c := c) hRn).2 hsub (mem_erase.2 ⟨hip, hi⟩)
        have hone := (D c).cover_unique _ hRc
        obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := card_eq_one.1 hone
        have hBmem := mem_filter.1 (hB ▸ mem_singleton_self B)
        refine ⟨blk n c B, ⟨?_, (hTeq B).2 hBmem.2⟩, ?_⟩
        · simp only [mem_biUnion, mem_univ, true_and, mem_image]; exact ⟨c, B, hBmem.1, rfl⟩
        · rintro B' ⟨hB', hsub⟩
          simp only [mem_biUnion, mem_univ, true_and, mem_image] at hB'
          obtain ⟨c', B'', hB'', rfl⟩ := hB'
          
          have hcc : c' = c := by
            have : p ∈ blk n c' B'' := hsub hpT
            rcases mem_insert.1 this with h2 | h2
            · apply Fin.ext; simp only [c]; omega
            · obtain ⟨a, -, ha⟩ := mem_map.1 h2
              have := a.isLt; simp at ha; omega
          rw [hcc] at hB'' hsub
          have : B'' ∈ (D c).blocks.filter (toFin n R ⊆ ·) := mem_filter.2 ⟨hB'', (hTeq B'').1 hsub⟩
          rw [hB, mem_singleton] at this
          rw [hcc, this]

name: Veles.LSC.not_largeSet_of_noExt
statement:
theorem not_largeSet_of_noExt {k n m : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    (h : NoExt (n + m) (k + 1) (dec (preOf n m k))) : ¬ LargeSet (k - 1) k n m
proof:
:= by
  intro hL
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := isCover_of_largeSet hk hL
  exact h F hF

name: Veles.Bits.ofMask_pm
statement: @[simp] theorem ofMask_pm (T : Finset ℕ) : ofMask (pm T) = T

name: Veles.Bits.pm_ofMask
statement: @[simp] theorem pm_ofMask (m : ℕ) : pm (ofMask m) = m

name: Veles.Bits.mem_ofMask
statement: theorem mem_ofMask {m i : ℕ} : i ∈ ofMask m ↔ m.testBit i

name: Veles.Bits.testBit_pm
statement: theorem testBit_pm (T : Finset ℕ) (i : ℕ) : (pm T).testBit i = decide (i ∈ T)
proof:
:= by
  have := @mem_ofMask (pm T) i
  rw [ofMask_pm] at this
  by_cases h : i ∈ T <;> simp_all

name: Veles.Bits.pm_injective
statement: theorem pm_injective : Function.Injective pm
proof:
:= fun a b h => by
  rw [← ofMask_pm a, h, ofMask_pm]

name: Veles.Bits.pm_erase
statement: theorem pm_erase {B : Finset ℕ} {y : ℕ} (hy : y ∈ B) : pm (B.erase y) = pm B ^^^ 2 ^ y
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq; intro i
  rw [Nat.testBit_xor, testBit_pm, testBit_pm, Nat.testBit_two_pow]
  by_cases h : i = y
  · subst h; simp [hy]
  · simp [h, Ne.symm h]

name: Veles.Bits.pm_insert
statement: theorem pm_insert (T : Finset ℕ) (x : ℕ) : pm (insert x T) = pm T ||| 2 ^ x
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq; intro i
  rw [Nat.testBit_lor, testBit_pm, testBit_pm, Nat.testBit_two_pow]
  by_cases h : i = x
  · subst h; simp
  · simp [h, Ne.symm h]

name: Veles.Bits.pm_lt
statement: theorem pm_lt {T : Finset ℕ} {v : ℕ} (hT : T ⊆ range v) : pm T < 2 ^ v
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.lt_pow_two_of_testBit
  intro i hi
  rw [testBit_pm]
  simp only [decide_eq_false_iff_not]
  intro h; have := mem_range.1 (hT h); omega

name: Veles.Bits.ofMask_subset_range
statement: theorem ofMask_subset_range {m v : ℕ} (hm : m < 2 ^ v) : ofMask m ⊆ range v
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  rw [mem_ofMask] at hi
  rw [mem_range]
  by_contra h
  rw [Nat.testBit_lt_two_pow (lt_of_lt_of_le hm (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)))] at hi
  exact absurd hi (by simp)

name: Veles.Bits.mem_dec
statement: theorem mem_dec {X : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ} : T ∈ dec X ↔ X.testBit (pm T) = true

name: Veles.Bits.dec_lor
statement: theorem dec_lor (X Y : ℕ) : dec (X ||| Y) = dec X ∪ dec Y

name: Veles.Bits.popc_eq_card
statement: theorem popc_eq_card (n m : ℕ) (hm : m < 2 ^ n) : popc n m = (ofMask m).card
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => simp at hm; subst hm; simp [popc, ofMask]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hm2 : m >>> 1 < 2 ^ n := by
      rw [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow, pow_one]; rw [pow_succ] at hm; omega
    rw [popc, ih _ hm2]
    
    have key : ofMask m = (if m % 2 = 1 then {0} else ∅) ∪ (ofMask (m >>> 1)).map ⟨(· + 1), add_left_injective 1⟩ := by
      ext i
      rw [mem_union, mem_map, mem_ofMask]
      rcases i with _ | i
      · simp only [Nat.testBit_zero]
        split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]
      · rw [Nat.testBit_succ]
        simp only [Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk, mem_ofMask, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow, pow_one]
        constructor
        · intro h; right; exact ⟨i, h, rfl⟩
        · rintro (h | ⟨j, hj, hji⟩)
          · split_ifs at h <;> simp at h
          · simp at hji; subst hji; exact hj
    rw [key, card_union_of_disjoint]
    · rw [card_map]; split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]; omega
    · rw [disjoint_left]; intro a ha hb
      split_ifs at ha
      · simp at ha; subst ha; simp at hb
      · simp at ha
